name: ATLAS
scientificQuestion: What is the detailed mechanism of electroweak symmetry breaking, are there additional Higgs states, what is dark matter, and do microscopic extra dimensions exist?
magnets: Central 2 T Solenoid + 8 outer Superconducting Air-Core Toroid coils (0.5 T / 1.0 T peak)

subdetectors.name: Inner Detector
subdetectors.role: Silicon Pixel, Semi-Conductor Tracker (SCT), Transition Radiation Tracker (TRT) measuring charged particle tracks and vertices in 2T solenoid field.

subdetectors.name: Liquid Argon (LAr) EM Calorimeter
subdetectors.role: Accordion geometry Pb-LAr sampling calorimeter measuring electron and photon energy with fine shower-shape segmentation.

subdetectors.name: Tile Hadronic Calorimeter
subdetectors.role: Steel/scintillating-tile sampling calorimeter measuring hadronic jets and missing transverse energy (MET).

subdetectors.name: Muon Spectrometer
subdetectors.role: MDT, CSC, RPC, and TGC chambers measuring muon momentum via deflection in large air-core toroid magnetic fields.

triggerSystem: Hardware Level-1 (40 MHz -> 100 kHz, 2.5 µs latency) + High-Level Trigger (HLT, commodity CPU farm, -> 1-3 kHz output)

name: CMS (Compact Muon Solenoid)
scientificQuestion: How does the Higgs boson couple to fermions and gauge bosons, and can we detect supersymmetric particles or dark matter candidates through complementary detector geometry?
magnets: Single superconducting solenoid coil (3.8 T) containing all-silicon tracker and crystal calorimeter.

subdetectors.name: All-Silicon Tracker
subdetectors.role: Silicon pixel + silicon strip tracker in 3.8 T field providing high-precision momentum resolution.

subdetectors.name: ECAL
subdetectors.role: 75,848 lead tungstate (PbWO4) scintillating crystals providing high energy resolution for photons and electrons.

subdetectors.name: HCAL
subdetectors.role: Brass and plastic scintillator sampling calorimeter.

subdetectors.name: Muon Chambers
subdetectors.role: Drift tubes, Cathode Strip Chambers, and RPCs embedded inside the 10,000-tonne steel return yoke.

triggerSystem: Level-1 hardware trigger (40 MHz -> 100 kHz, 3.2 µs latency) + software HLT farm (-> 1 kHz output)

name: ALICE
scientificQuestion: What are the physical properties and thermodynamic equation of state of Quark-Gluon Plasma (QGP), the deconfined state of matter existing microseconds after the Big Bang?
magnets: L3 Solenoid magnet (0.5 T) + Forward Muon Dipole magnet (0.7 T)

subdetectors.name: Time Projection Chamber (TPC)
subdetectors.role: Largest gaseous detector tracking thousands of charged particle tracks simultaneously in Pb-Pb events.

subdetectors.name: Inner Tracking System (ITS)
subdetectors.role: Monolithic Active Pixel Sensors (MAPS) measuring displaced vertices and heavy flavour charm/beauty mesons.

subdetectors.name: Time Of Flight (TOF)
subdetectors.role: Multigap Resistive Plate Chambers identifying pions, kaons, and protons by flight time.

triggerSystem: Continuous readout in Run 3 (50 kHz Pb-Pb collision rate without hardware trigger)

name: LHCb
scientificQuestion: Why is the universe predominantly matter rather than antimatter? Searches for subtle CP violation in beauty and charm hadrons and rare loop decays sensitive to new virtual particles.
magnets: Warm dipole magnet with 4 T*m integrated field

subdetectors.name: VELO (Vertex Locator)
subdetectors.role: Silicon pixel sensors placed just 5.1 mm from the colliding proton beams.

subdetectors.name: RICH 1 & RICH 2
subdetectors.role: Ring Imaging Cherenkov detectors separating pions, kaons, and protons across 2 to 100 GeV/c.

subdetectors.name: Tracking Stations & Muon System
subdetectors.role: Scintillating fiber tracker and MWPC chambers.

triggerSystem: Full software trigger in Run 3 processing 30 MHz beam crossings on GPUs (Allen framework)

name: Antimatter Factory (ALPHA, AEgIS, ASACUSA, BASE, GBAR)
scientificQuestion: Do matter and antimatter obey identical physical laws under CPT symmetry, and how does gravity affect antimatter?

subdetectors.name: Penning-Malmberg Traps
subdetectors.role: Cryogenic superconducting traps confining antiprotons and positrons in UHV.

subdetectors.name: Laser Spectroscopy System
subdetectors.role: Probes 1S-2S electronic transition in antihydrogen to 12 decimal places.

subdetectors.name: Gravity Interferometers
subdetectors.role: Measures free fall acceleration g of neutral antihydrogen atoms.

name: AWAKE
scientificQuestion: Can proton-driven plasma wakefields achieve accelerating gradients 100 to 1000 times higher than conventional radiofrequency cavities?

subdetectors.name: Rubidium Plasma Cell
subdetectors.role: 10 m laser-ionized rubidium vapor supporting wakefields over 1 GV/m.

subdetectors.name: Electron Spectrometer
subdetectors.role: Measures electron beam energy accelerated from 19 MeV to 2 GeV in 10 meters.

name: CLOUD
scientificQuestion: How do galactic cosmic rays and aerosol emissions influence cloud droplet formation and Earth's climate?

name: n_TOF (Neutron Time-of-Flight)
scientificQuestion: What are the exact neutron-nucleus capture and fission cross sections required for stellar nucleosynthesis and advanced nuclear energy technologies?
accelerator: PS (20 GeV proton beam on lead spallation target)

name: FASER & FASERnu
scientificQuestion: Can we detect light, extremely weakly interacting long-lived particles (dark photons, ALPs) and collider neutrinos emitted in the far-forward direction along the beam collision axis?
